title: MiDM: Minimal Decision Models and an audit of CLM-8B
description: Code and results for a controlled study of small (8B or fewer parameters) typed-decision models. MiDM is a LoRA-tuned causal LM with a pointer head over option lines. The release also contains an exact reproduction and statistical audit of the CLM-8B DeepSWE verifier claim, and it shows which factors matter for transfer to unseen sources: base-model generation and balanced data breadth. Adapter variants, TTA, calibration and ensembles did not help.
